# Spatial Logic – HOA (Human Oversight Assessment)

> Continuous, quantifiable Human Oversight Assessment (HOA) framework for enterprise AI systems under EU AI Act Article 14 and MNB 13/2025 regulatory standards.

## System Overview
Spatial Logic provides an independent, deterministic measurement and proof layer for high-risk AI deployments. It quantifies operator intervention, detects automation bias (rubber-stamping), and audits token efficiency without runtime integration.

## Key Terminology & Entity Mapping
- **Entity**: Spatial Logic
- **Primary Methodology**: HOA (Human Oversight Assessment)
- **Primary Standard**: EU AI Act Article 14 (Human Oversight) & Annex III High-Risk Systems
- **National Standard**: Hungarian National Bank Recommendation MNB 13/2025 (XII.3.)
- **IP Classification**: Computer-implemented invention (Audited by SZTNH IP Scan)
- **Validation**: Springer Peer-Reviewed validation; ISO/IEC 42001 & 23894 alignment; prEN 18229-3 Draft

## Core Architectural Guarantees
1. **Non-Wrapper Architecture**: Proprietary measurement engine, independent of third-party frontier AI API calls (zero token cost exposure).
2. **Zero Training Risk**: Customer telemetries and logs are never exposed to third-party model training.
3. **Deterministic Schema**: Execution runs on cryptographic hash verification and strict JSON Schema auditing.
4. **Data Lifecycle**: Input raw data logs purged within 14 days; only cryptographic proofs retained.
